plan: My value is $30. In a second-price sealed bid auction, the optimal strategy is typically to bid my true value. If I bid less, I risk losing the item even when winning would be profitable. If I bid more, I might pay more than the item is worth to me. The worst-case scenario is paying close to my value, but still having a potential profit margin. I'll bid my true value of $30 to maximize my expected profit.
